title: Enable READ COMMITTED SNAPSHOT Isolation
description: Enable row versioning-based isolation to reduce blocking in a busy database.

data.text: Your application experiences frequent blocking between readers and writers. Enable READ COMMITTED SNAPSHOT at the database level to use row versioning instead of shared locks for read operations.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: READ COMMITTED SNAPSHOT (RCSI) uses tempdb to store row versions. Readers see the version of data as of the start of their statement (not transaction). This eliminates most reader-writer blocking. It requires tempdb space and adds overhead on writes. ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION enables SNAPSHOT level (statement-start versioning per transaction).
